options.name: desired_retention
options.description: The retention value for the Snapshot. If the desired_retention is not mentioned during creation, snapshot will be created with unlimited retention. Maximum supported desired retention is 31 days.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: remove_mode
options.description: Removal mode for the snapshot. It defaults to C(ONLY_ME), if not specified.

options.name: retention_unit
options.description: The unit for retention. It defaults to C(hours), if not specified.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: The name of the snapshot. Mandatory for create operation. Specify either I(snapshot_name) or I(snapshot_id) (but not both) for any operation.

options.name: snapshot_new_name
options.description: New name of the snapshot. Used to rename the snapshot.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vol_name
options.description: The name of the volume for which snapshot will be taken. Specify either I(vol_name) or I(vol_id) while creating snapshot.
